title: Elastic Co. — Log Telemetry Gap
description: U8: notification-service logs silent last ~20 min while APM and pods stay healthy. Triage telemetry (agent/ingest), not rollback checkout-api.

config.content:
## Elastic Co. — Log telemetry gap

**notification-service** logs went silent last ~20 minutes. APM transactions and pod metrics still flow. Triage: **telemetry failed, not the app.** Alert `elasticco-log-telemetry-gap` opens a case. Do **not** start `elasticco-detect-remediate`. Close: restart elastic-agent / check ingest — not checkout rollback, not SkuCache INFO. Time range **Last 2 hours**.

data_source.query:
FROM logs-elasticco.notification-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 hours AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| STATS count = COUNT(*) WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 15 minutes

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 15 minutes AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND service.name == "notification-service"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elasticco.notification-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-elasticco.notification-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 2 hours AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| STATS last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)

FROM logs-elasticco.notification-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 40, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT bucket

FROM traces-apm-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE processor.event == "transaction" AND service.name == "notification-service"
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 40, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT bucket

config.content:
### Triage

1. Alert `elasticco-log-telemetry-gap` firing → Observability case.
2. Discover **Elastic Co. Notification Logs** — last event ~20 min ago.
3. APM → **notification-service** — transactions continue.
4. EKS pod metrics — CPU/restarts healthy. **Fix ingest, not the app.**

data_source.query:
FROM metrics-elasticco.k8s.pod-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE service.name == "notification-service"
| STATS cpu = AVG(kubernetes.pod.cpu.usage.nanocores), restarts = MAX(kubernetes.pod.restart.count)

FROM metrics-elasticco.k8s.pod-default
| WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND labels.demo == "elastic-co"
| WHERE service.name == "notification-service"
| STATS cpu = AVG(kubernetes.pod.cpu.usage.nanocores), restarts = MAX(kubernetes.pod.restart.count)
